refsection.title: Description
refsection.para:
The `SilikoSyntaxTreeNodeType` represents whether a syntax tree node is a branch, leaf, or a simple placeholder.
* `SILIKO_AST_NOTHING` represents a syntax tree node that was generated by a parser to indicate that a rule was not able to process further input, but is not in an error condition. This is used, for example, to indicate that the end of a list has been reached by a function that does not process the end of list indicator or the next operator being processed. * `SILIKO_AST_BRANCH` represents a syntax tree that is a branch. A branch node will have an operator name, and an array of child `SyntaxTreeNode` objects. * `SILIKO_AST_LEAF` represents a syntax tree that is a leaf. The node has no child nodes, and is either a value or an error.
